Hi John / Amaya security team —

Great speaking with you earlier. Quick recap and the asks we discussed so we can keep things moving on the procurement side:

- Redwood product + pricing conversation: covered (thanks for the time).
- Security/compliance items for your team to review: SOC 2 status, GDPR/HIPAA applicability, and vendor security questionnaire (VSQ).
- Data retention / deletion specifics: you asked for our deletion SLA for customer data, how long logs are retained, and what happens to backups.

Next steps we agreed on:
1) I will send our short data-retention summary and SOC 2 status note (attached).
2) John / security team to share your vendor security questionnaire (or SharePoint link).
3) Neha (security/compliance) will follow up with specifics on deletion SLA, backups, and options for stricter contractual terms.
4) We'll aim to return a completed VSQ within 3 business days and identify any contract redlines.

Quick asks for you: can you confirm the timeline your procurement/compliance team needs (e.g., decision by end of month)? Also, any mandatory clauses around log retention or backup purging we should be aware of up front?

Attachments: redwood-data-retention-summary.pdf (summary of current default retention & deletion behavior), SOC2-status-summary.docx.

Thanks —

A couple of clarifying points from my side:

- For logs: any logs that contain customer PII must be deletable on request and removed from backups within 30 days of deletion request. Is that possible?

I'll loop in procurement/legal after we get Neha's confirmation on the specifics.

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: Security & data retention follow-up (SOC 2, deletion SLAs, logs/backups)

Hi John —

Thanks for the timeline. Quick answers to the items you flagged (high-level; happy to expand or put clauses in the DPA):

- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II (Security) most recently in 2026; summary attached (SOC2-status-summary.docx). We can provide the full report under NDA.
- DPA / HIPAA: We support a standard DPA and are open to HIPAA BA for covered workloads. I'll have legal provide the standard language we use; if you have specific BA language, we can review.
- Deletion SLA: Our standard deletion SLA for customer data is 30 days for primary data. For sensitive PII-bearing logs we offer a contractual option to accelerate deletion and guarantee removal from accessible backups within 30 days of a deletion request; however immutable archival backups (if you require longer-term archives) can be excluded by policy or encrypted with customer-managed keys and retention windows negotiated in the contract.
- Logs: By default, application and inference logs are retained for 90 days and system logs for 365 days. We can configure shorter retention for your account (e.g., 30 days) as part of the Dedicated or Private deployment options.
- Backups: Backups are encrypted at rest. Backup retention varies by product and region; we purge backups in line with deletion requests where feasible, but for some object-level snapshots removal is on a best-effort basis unless we agree to stricter contractual terms (or use customer-managed encryption keys to force inaccessibility).

Attachments: redwood-data-retention-summary.pdf (detailed retention table), SOC2-status-summary.docx.

Proposed next steps:
1) I'll have Legal circulate our DPA + optional BA language by tomorrow.
2) Marissa: can you prepare a short appendix that lists the account-level retention override (30-day logs + deletion guarantee) as a commercial add-on?
3) John: once we have your VSQ answers we can highlight items that need redlines.

Happy to hop on a 20-min call with your compliance team if that speeds things up.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
